text: Existing evidence about risk-shifting by the average derivative-using mutual fund is less relevant to unconstrained mutual funds, because their derivative use is closer to that of a typical private fund.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: show that derivative use by UMFs is closer to that of a typical private fund, which may mean that the absence of evidence on risk-shifting by the average mutual fund that engages in derivatives transactions is less relevant.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: unconstrained mutual funds whose derivative use resembles private fund practice
